pages.text: The lord of Utgard, who stole Thor's hammer. He breathes frost ahead of him and stamps so hard that everything around flies off.
Enraged, he calls two frost giants. Fire hurts him twice as much; do not stand right in front of him. Drops Mjolnir.
Thor was the bane of giants: Mjolnir strikes every giant and troll twice as hard, and Thrym, who stole it, three times as hard. Take it back and carry it to Muspelheim.
Mjolnir's lightning melts sand into glass and chars the grass and soil around it into black scorched earth.
